newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha see-saws with crude, ends steady.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha see-saws with crude, ends steady.

text.p: NWE naphtha see-sawed with crude on Friday before ending the day broadly unchanged.

The prospect of increasing supply following the closure of the Asian arbitrage window has limited the bulls' potential. Demand from petchem buyers also looks relaxed which could further depress prices.
NWE cargoes were pegged around $176 cif NWE.
Demand could pick up a touch towards the end of the month, but significant short-term price boosts were not expected aside from crude gains, traders said.
